title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Semis explode, tech leads, energy fades. Mega-cap tech and semiconductors surged on AI momentum — QQQ +3.30% and SOXX +8.50% dwarfed small caps (IWM +1.39%). Dollar weakness (-0.99%) and falling oil (-1.42%) fueled a narrow risk-on rotation into growth, while defensives XLP and XLC sold off.

INDICES — VIX 17.1, down 6.48%. Return ranking: SOXX +8.50%, QQQ +3.30%, SPY +1.68%, IWM +1.39%, DIA +1.18%. Large > small by 1.91pp. Cross-asset: dollar -0.99%, gold +1.64%, oil -1.42%. SPY and QQQ above 200-day MA — no CTA trigger.

VOLUME — QQQ vol_ratio 1.8x, SPY vol_ratio near the index average of 1.25x (not elevated). QQQ volume up with price = accumulation; SOXX 1.7x confirms. DIA 0.9x declining. In sectors, XLK 1.7x accumulation, XLC 1.5x distribution. Small-cap indices IJR 0.8x signal low-conviction rally.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLK +5.50%, XLI +0.98%, XLY +0.70%, XLF +0.56%, XLE +0.53%, XLB -0.19%, XLU -0.56%, XLRE -1.44%, XLV -1.64%, XLP -2.16%, XLC -2.68%. Top industries: WGMI +22.10%, DRAM +16.70%; bottom: IHI -1.05%, SCHH -1.45%. Money flows into tech and semis, out of defensives (XLP, XLC) and real estate. Rotation state: AI hardware leading.

POSITIONING — SPY PCR_vol 1.23 (elevated protection), QQQ 1.32. IV skew positive (+10.9% SPY, +11.0% QQQ) = fear. SPY GEX flip at 750.0 — spot likely below, amplifying dealer hedging. VIX at its 20-day MA (17.2), neutral fear. No bond vol stress (MOVE 0.0).

CROSS-ASSET — Dollar -0.99% and oil -1.42% aligned with tech risk-on, but gold +1.64% and silver +3.34% rallied simultaneously — an unusual divergence where dollar weakness trumped the risk-on rotation for metals.

SIGNALS & WATCH — Fear & Greed 60.5 (Greed). Top movers: MSFT +15.51% (Mag 7, vol 3.6x accumulation), PWR +17.26% (Buildout, vol 3.0x accumulation), LHX -8.61% (Defense, vol 3.6x distribution). 20d momentum extremes: XLE best (+11.65%), SOXX worst (-15.87%) but today massive bounce. No single catalyst identified. Watch: MU +3.28% (semis momentum carry), LRCX +5.4% (post-earnings vol spike accumulation), ICLN +4.74% (vol 3.1x clean energy reawakening).
